prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: frozen ambiguous visual query for a controlled shopping retrieval experiment, not an exact catalogue product reconstruction. Primary request: create a single square natural product reference photo. Subject: A single generic child-sized U-shaped soft silicone mouthpiece toothbrush with fine soft silicone bristles around the inside curved mouthpiece and a small rounded pastel handle easy for small hands to grip. No packaging, no child, no printed symbols. Style: realistic ordinary photo with gently soft focus and modest detail, product category and overall geometry recognizable, no brand-specific identity. Composition: entire item centered with generous margins on a plain light neutral background, soft diffuse lighting, no collage. Text: none. Constraints: absolutely no brand name, product name, readable text, letters, numbers, watermark, logo, trademark, label, barcode or recognizable branded pattern anywhere. No caption. Do not add feature labels or marketing graphics. One photo only.

review.reviewer: 当前会话主智能体逐张视觉核对
review.notes: 已实际查看生成图：粉色小握柄及透明柔软弯曲刷头，无包装、品牌或商品名字样。
review.ambiguity_definition: 保留品类与一般可见外形，无品牌身份和商品名称；轻微柔焦，不依靠事后选图或检索排名。
